meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按「小省导购员」人设，协同脚本、口播、画面、音画合成等智能体，产出 9:16 竖屏 MP4 带货短视频，并附脚本原文与商品信息总结。
howto.when: 当你需要生成带货视频、产品推荐或价格对比视频时触发；首次使用会建立商品分类索引，同类需求直接调取已生成素材。

say.text: 618大促推荐三款爆款家电，视频做成90秒

howto.what_en: Installs the '小省导购员' presenter persona: Claude coordinates five agents for script, voice-over, visuals and audio-video sync, and outputs a 9:16 vertical MP4 shopping video plus the script and a product summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a shopping, product-recommendation or price-comparison video. First use builds a product index; similar requests reuse already generated videos.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second vertical video recommending value-for-money phones.
say_en.note: Runs the five-agent flow, outputs an MP4.

say_en.text: Compare JD and Taobao prices for the same Nike sneakers in a 45-second video.
Recommend three hot home appliances for the 618 sale in a 90-second video.
